rows.scope_description: Contractor general requirements: mobilisation, site establishment, project management and staff, bonds and insurances, management plans, permits and authority approvals, reporting and demobilisation (lump sum).

rows.package: Design Works (lump sum, allocated to items)
rows.scope_description: Design of all works through Concept, Preliminary and Detailed Design / IFC stages, including submittals to SAR for review and approval (lump sum, allocated to the BOQ items).
Design and construction of the passenger station main building, GEA 1,100 m2, single storey: structure, architectural finishes and building services.
Supply, installation and commissioning of IT equipment for the station building.
Supply and installation of furniture, fixtures and equipment (FF&E) for the station building.
Substation and SEC works: power supply room and incoming electrical connection for the station.
Design and construction of the firefighting building, GEA 518 m2.
Design and construction of the generator room, 62 m2, with the standby generator.
Construction of the underground water tank, including related fittings and connections.
Site preparation and underground utilities for the 15,000 m2 plot: earthworks, drainage, water, sewage and cable ducts.

rows.descriptor: BOQ 1,375 m2 (80 lots in management model)
rows.scope_description: Car parking sheds, 1,375 m2 (80 lots in the management model).
Station access road, about 1,700 m dual carriageway, including pavement, drainage, lighting and markings.
Signalling and telecommunication systems for the station and loop line.
External above-ground works: paving, landscaping and finishing around the station.
Railway track works for the loop line, 2,500 m.
Railway turnout works connecting the loop line to the main line.
